name: Alabama Cable Telecomm Associates
old_description: Founded in 1965, ACBA serves as the advocate for our cable providers, operators, suppliers and programmers.
about:
The Alabama Cable & Broadband Association (ACBA) is headquartered in Montgomery, Alabama, and was founded in 1965. It operates as a trade association representing cable providers, operators, suppliers, and programmers across the state. The organization was established to give the cable industry a unified voice in legislative, regulatory, and taxation matters at the state level.

ACBA does not manufacture physical products. Instead, it provides advocacy, policy representation, and industry coordination for its member companies. Its activities include lobbying, regulatory monitoring, public affairs, and facilitating industry collaboration on broadband deployment and technology issues. The association’s staff works from its Montgomery office to engage with lawmakers, state agencies, and other stakeholders.

The association serves the cable and broadband telecommunications industry in Alabama. Its members include cable system operators, programmers, equipment suppliers, and related service providers. ACBA’s advocacy covers issues such as broadband expansion, spectrum policy, taxation, and regulatory reform that affect the cable sector statewide. The organization also highlights the industry’s economic contributions, citing more than 3,000 jobs and a $3.56 billion economic impact across Alabama.

ACBA was started to ensure the cable industry remained competitive amid rapid changes in technology, information, and communication services. Its stated purpose is to provide members with a unified voice throughout the legislative process and to support the industry’s role in education, economic development, and quality of life in Alabama.
